title: Laurent tries to play a number
summary: Laurent attempts to play a number on the clarinet, tires, and mentions the many orchestrations he kept by the piano.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone

blocks.x: Sometimes I get so. I can't sing. I'll stay off it too long. I'm trying to think of that number but I can't.
